title: Natural History of Enthusiasm
author: Isaac Taylor

description: "Natural History of Enthusiasm" by Isaac Taylor is a philosophical examination and critical account of the concept of enthusiasm, particularly within religious contexts, written in the mid-19th century. The work scrutinizes various forms of what Taylor terms "fictitious piety" that often masquerade as genuine religious emotions, highlighting how enthusiasm can lead to distortions of true faith.
